jfk.text: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.

librispeech-1272-128104-0004.text: Linnell's pictures are a sort of upguards and Adam paintings, and Mason's exquisite idols are as national as a Jingo poem.
